Condition report

Needle: ODT-CONDITION-6673

1. Roof

The felt at the north corner has lifted. Tacks have pulled clean through the substrate and the overlap is no longer weathertight.

2. Walls

The east wall shows hairline cracking above both window heads, consistent with historic settlement rather than active movement.

3. Drainage

The rear gully is blocked with leaf litter. The soakaway could not be located and may have been built over.

Prepared by Bea Okonkwo, 2026-03-14.
